name: GammaOS Turnip - Adreno 613 tuned (VK 1.3, UBWC-off + FS wide-wave)
description: Self-built Mesa Turnip tuned for the Adreno 613 (gen6_3): forced multiview so it advertises Vulkan 1.3, fragment shaders opt into 128-wide waves, and UBWC framebuffer compression disabled (a measured net loss on this GPU). Reaches 93-96 percent of the stock Adreno blob in real titles while exposing Vulkan 1.3 and ~150 device extensions for DXVK/Winlator, emulators and Zink. Built against Android API 31.
author: TheGammaSqueeze
